summary: Applied the spec-review repair by defining the durable owner and transaction boundary for post-command dispatcher/agent runtime and metric metadata.

items.title: Post-command runtime/metric writes are not assigned an owner or commit boundary
items.rationale: The spec now states that post-command dispatcher runtimeLog metadata and agent metrics produced after the final flow.json snapshot must use target-worktree-external durable storage and must not mutate final flow.json after the cleanup commit.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules, overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, requirements R2/R6, acceptance_criteria, and tasks T-1 now cover the owner and transaction boundary.
